exposure: model of care (degree of midwifery autonomy)
outcome: intrapartum transfer of care (TOC) from midwife to obstetrician-led maternity care
cohort: The study included 1772 low-risk women whose intrapartum care was initiated by a midwife, selected from a total of 2126 low-risk women.
finding: The model of care and obstetric unit size (OUS) significantly affect the prevalence of intrapartum transfer of care (TOC) and various birth outcomes.
mod_finding: Statistically significant differences were observed between obstetric unit size (OUS) and type of birth.
